card.name: Trepak
card.tagline: Ukraine's Cossack squat-and-kick dance — the prysiadka leap immortalised by Tchaikovsky’s Nutcracker, Russian classical ballet, and every Slavic wedding.
card.profile: Trepak or tropak is a traditional East Slavic folk dance . The dance is included in the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage List of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, whose form is preserved in Tacheng.
